text:
carla: quick brain dump — proposing we merge Models + Deployments + Runtimes under one left-rail parent called 'Inference'. mock: https://img.redwood/mock/compact-inference.png. main asks: deep-link landing behavior, permalink stability, and breadcrumb semantics.

 tom: 👍 on declutter. permalinks worry me — we need server-side redirects for old slugs. also keep canonical routes stable for docs.

 carla: plan: keep canonical route /inference/...; add a redirect table for /models -> /inference/models for 120 days, telemetry when redirect used.

 olivia: a11y checklist: ensure nav uses role="navigation", breadcrumbs are nav>ol>li, aria-current on active item, and when deep-link expands the parent, set aria-expanded and move focus to main H1. also respect prefers-reduced-motion for any expand animation.

 nate: router notes: do real routes not hashes. on deep links expand parent before mount to avoid SR announcing out-of-order. use history.replaceState for UI-only toggles so back button isn't polluted. preserve query params across redirects (e.g., ?eval=42).

 jenny: mobile concern: icon-only rail should still permit deep link landing. suggestion: deep-link should override collapsed preference once (session-only) so users land in content but their saved preference isn't overwritten.

 olivia: QA: verify focus landing, screenreader full breadcrumb readout when visual breadcrumb truncates, keyboard focus for icon mode, and preserved query params after redirect.

 tom: copy/UI: keep the shelf label technical ('Inference') vs friendlier ('Serve')? my vote = Inference plus tooltip: "Models, deployments, and runtimes for serving models". less ambiguous.

 carla: agree. i'll run a quick hallway poll. also propose a small transient banner when redirect occurs: "You were redirected from /models/123 to /inference/models/123" with dismiss to help catch stale links.

 devops-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.redwood/pr/1622 (inference-rail). includes keyboard walkthrough and a11y notes.

 nate: saw preview — minor bug: prototype used fragment toggles so breadcrumb didn't update. will switch to route-based expansion and pre-resolve redirects before rendering breadcrumb to avoid flash.

 carla: action items: nate implements pre-resolve+history handling, tom drafts redirect mapping + FF rollout plan, olivia publishes QA checklist, jenny tests mobile collapsed override. meet tomorrow after small lab tests. :thumbsup:
